title: US Divorce Fell To 2.4 Per Thousand
hook: The US divorce rate nearly halved to 2.4 per thousand.
closing: Later marriage and fewer divorces challenge the idea that relationships keep getting less stable.
question: Why do you think divorce fell?

segments.say: The US divorce rate fell to 2.4 per thousand. The long rise people remember has reversed.
Women first marry at a median age of 28.6. Later marriage now accompanies fewer breakups.
